rawContent: You cannot claim #BlackLivesMatter at School if you continue to support restraint & seclusion given how it lands in the lives of Black disabled youth. It's a chance for those to surveil & punish Black disabled youth. 2/

@ShanaVWhite's voice is desperately needed on Twitter. As BIWoC, we are harassed and @TwitterSupport stays silent. Do what is right @Twitter and lift the ban. All those actions Twitter took around #BlackLivesMatter don't mean much when you allow harassment of BIWoC #onhere.

Please note what is happening at University of Kansas too. It's not faculty, it's staff- BIPOC &/or queer- that are working with the most vulnerable students who have been cut. Universities will say #BlackLivesMatter in June & terminate those fighting for Black lives in December

Join @WakeUpNewJersey @mildredboveda, Wit Lopez & me hosted by @Okaikor @justmaybechris @denisha_jones @BLMAtSchool to center Black disabled youth, their families & communities. All eds interested in anti-racism, abolitionist pedagogy & #BlackLivesMatter welcome 3:30 PST tomorrow
